DIAGNOSIS READY: Frozen Shoulder (Adhesive Capsulitis)

The clinical presentation of insidious onset pain, worsening with extreme range of motion, significant stiffness, and difficulty with activities like brushing hair in a 55-year-old woman without trauma is classic for adhesive capsulitis. The normal inflammatory markers (CBC, ESR, CRP) and absence of fever or skin changes rule out cellulitis. I will proceed with imaging to confirm the diagnosis and rule out rotator cuff tears.
